create_bucket: create a storage bucket on Hugging Face Hub with a given namespace and name using HfApi.create_bucket
test_bucket_info: test retrieving bucket metadata including id and private flag via HfApi.bucket_info
test_list_buckets: test listing buckets by namespace with HfApi.list_buckets filtering public and private results
test_copy_files: test copying files and folders between buckets and repos using HfApi.copy_files with path semantics
test_download_bucket_files: test downloading files from a bucket with HfApi.download_bucket_files handling missing and truncated files
